thread:
Maya: dropped a small update to the alert details mock. adds a compact playbook row + a shortened 'snooze' pill state. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/preview-playbook
Ravi: nice overall. main concern is density on mobile and narrow widths 1: the playbook row increases height. can we collapse by default?
Maya: yes — collapsed summary line with 'View playbook' CTA. expand shows link, owner, and last-run.
Tess: copy nit: prefer 'View playbook' over 'Open runbook' to match ops docs. also contrast: snooze pill text fails dark mode contrast.
Sam: accessibility: collapse toggle needs proper aria-expanded and keyboard focus styles. also when snooze is applied we should announce via `aria-live` to provide feedback to screen readers.
Ravi: perf: inline previews should be lazy-loaded and cached; don't fetch playbook content for every alert in a long list.
Maya: proposal: details rail shows full editable playbook; list shows metadata tile + a hover/focus preview snippet (200 chars cached).
Tess: UI behaviour: the channel preview in the alert should show "Would notify: #channel, PagerDuty" (resolved destinations) not the routing rule name. less confusing for users.
Sam: small copy change: quick action label 'Mute' -> 'Snooze' across menus. Ops folks expect that term.
Maya: will update Figma and add a11y annotations. sync tomorrow 9:30?
